answer:
Your October budget note now has a page with three parts:
- **Total vs limit:** it shows 12 357,50 kr spent and 2 642,50 kr left of your 15 000 kr limit. A bar above the categories shows how the spending splits.
- **By category:** each category has its amount and share. Housing is the biggest, then food, transport, subscriptions and fun.
- **Add an expense:** a form with What, Amount and Category, dated today. It also has a Limit field and a list of your latest expenses.

To make this work I turned your bullet list into a table with Date, Item, Category and Amount columns. All eight expenses are in it. I kept your "Limit this month: 15 000 kr" line and also saved the limit in the page settings. If you change the limit in the page, the line in the note won't update, so the note's text can go out of date.
